title: Family Halloween Outfits: Plan Daytime and Evening Layers
description: Pumpkin patch photos and evening plans can call for different layers. Pick a shared fall color, then check the forecast and plan what each person can wear over or under their outfit. Before buying, check each product's size chart and compare measurements as directed. Read our Halloween family outfit guide for styling ideas and current shopping links.
